title: Open-closed exact sequence for sheaves on a Noetherian space
statement: Let X be a Noetherian topological space (meaning every nonempty set of closed subsets has a minimal element for inclusion), let j:U \to X be the inclusion of an open subset with closed complement i:Z \to X, and let F be an abelian sheaf on X [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. There is a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves 0 \to j_!j^*F \to F \to i_*i^*F \to 0. Moreover j_!j^*F is the direct image along a closed immersion of a sheaf on the closure of U, so its cohomology is computed on that closed subspace [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward].

proof.text: The open inclusion gives the adjunction map $a:j_!j^*F\to F$ of [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks], where $j^*F=F|_U$. Let $i^*F=i^{-1}F$ be the inverse image along $i:Z\to X$ and $b=\eta_F:F\to i_*i^*F$ the unit of $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], so $b_V=\eta_{F,V}:F(V)\to(i^*F)(V\cap Z)$ for $V\subseteq X$ open, $i_*$ being the direct-image formula of [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-abelian-stalks]. At each point of $U$, the stalk of $a$ is the identity on $F_x$ by the extension-by-zero stalk formula, and the stalk of $i_*i^*F$ is zero by the closed-pushforward formula applied to $Z$; hence the stalk sequence is $0\to F_x\xrightarrow{1}F_x\to0\to0$.

source.place: Lemma 02UT (lemma-canonical-exact-sequence), proof at points of the open; Sheaves, Lemmas 00A5 and 00AE

proof.text: At each $z\in Z$, the stalk of $j_!j^*F$ is zero by [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks]. The natural germ map $(i_*i^*F)_z\to(i^*F)_z$ is an isomorphism by [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-abelian-stalks]. By [lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk] applied to $i$ and $F$, the isomorphism $c_F:F_z\to(i^*F)_z$ sends $s_z$ to $(\eta_{F,V}(s))_z$ for $s\in F(V)$, $V\ni z$. Under these identifications $b_z$ sends $s_z$ to the germ of $b_V(s)=\eta_{F,V}(s)$, hence is the identity on $F_z$. Thus the stalk sequence is $0\to0\to F_z\xrightarrow{1}F_z\to0$.

source.place: Lemma 02UT (lemma-canonical-exact-sequence), proof at points of the closed complement; Sheaves, Lemma 00AE

proof.text: The two stalk calculations cover all points of $X$ and give short exact sequences. By [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-short-exact-stalkwise], the maps $a,b$ therefore form the asserted short exact sequence of abelian sheaves. The construction by restriction is natural in $F$.

Put $G=j_!j^*F$ and let $Z'=\overline U$, a closed subset with inclusion $i':Z'\to X$. Every $x\notin Z'$ lies outside $U$, so $G_x=0$ by [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks]. Let $F'=i'^{-1}G$ and $c=\eta_G:G\to i'_*F'$ the unit [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], $c_V:G(V)\to F'(V\cap Z')$. For $x\notin Z'$ both stalks are zero by [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-abelian-stalks]; for $x\in Z'$, that node identifies $(i'_*F')_x$ with $F'_x$ by germs, and [lem-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image-stalk] identifies $G_x$ with $F'_x$ by $s_x\mapsto(\eta_{G,V}(s))_x$. On these germs $c_x$ is the identity. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-iso-on-stalks] to the underlying sheaves of sets; the inverse of a bijective additive map on every open is additive, so $c$ is an isomorphism of abelian sheaves.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ (proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), first paragraph of proof: support on the closure of U and closed pushforward

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] to $i':Z'\to X$ and $F'$ from Step 4. It gives $H^p(Z',F')\cong H^p(X,i'_*F')$ for every $p\geq0$. The isomorphism $G\cong i'_*F'$ of Step 4 identifies the right side with $H^p(X,j_!j^*F)$, as claimed.
